statements.t: Factors that have impacted our cost of revenue, or that we expect may impact cost of revenue in future periods, also include: changes in the mix of products delivered, customer location and regional mix, changes in the cost of our inventory, investments to support expansion of cloud and customer support offerings as well as our customer success organization, changes in product warranty, incurrence of retrofit…

Factors that we expect may impact our cost of revenue in future periods include the same factors in the prior quarter, changes in trade policies and increased memory and other component prices due to shortages caused by the large scale build-out of AI infrastructure.

Our primary focus has been, and in the near term is expected to be, the U.S. and Canada given our large, direct sales and marketing presence and the amount of government stimulus being invested into underserved and not-served areas of these countries.

We expect our investments in sales and marketing will increase in absolute dollars on a year-over-year basis, but decline as a percentage of revenue as we continue to land new customers and expand our platform, cloud and managed services and approach new markets such as MDU and managed business.

We expect our investments in research and development to decrease in absolute dollars as we return to a more normal level of investment after we accelerated the development and delivery of Agent Workforce Cloud over the past year.
We expect our general and administrative investments to increase in absolute dollars but decline as a percentage of revenue.

If we are unable to generate sufficient cash flows or obtain other sources of liquidity, we will be forced to limit or terminate our stock repurchase program, limit our development activities, reduce our investment in growth initiatives and/or institute cost-cutting measures, all of which may adversely impact our business and potential growth.
